title: Everyone Except One
statement:
For each position `i`, take the greatest common divisor of all the numbers except `a_i`. Print the sum of these `n` values.

## Input
The first line contains `n`. The second line contains `a_1 ... a_n`.

## Output
Print the sum.

## Constraints
- `2 <= n <= 16000`
- `1 <= a_i <= 10^9`
